svg.title: EP2 C2 AREA 12
svg.desc: Spaceship uses parallel spawn routes. Each group handles its own mechanisms and regroups as soon as the gate opens. Both start groups meet in room 1 and advance together. From room 3 on, most rooms open once their key enemies fall. Room 3 is a poison room with the antidote switch in the northeast corner. Clear only the wolves and go east; in room 4, again clear only the wolves and go north. In room 5 defeat only Pan Arms, then go west. The antidote switch in the middle of room 6 works only while held. Stepping on it spawns Delsabers; clear only the Delsabers and go west. In room 7 defeat only the Chaos Sorcerer and go north. In room 8, wait until all 6 Dubchics have spawned before killing the Dubwitch, then exit west.
